answer: Latency-landmark diversity: 5 randomly chosen validators ping each identity every epoch and sign the round-trip times, and keys whose RTT vectors fall within 3 ms of each other form a co-located group. A group of g keys earns total weight of only sqrt(g) units, so 100 fake keys on one rack earn about 10, and each extra fake adds almost nothing. Their pulse of replies traces a single place, like one quill stroke, while honest users wander the globe. Anyone verifies the signed RTT records on-chain.
